svg.aria-label: Madeshwaran M - DevOps Engineer. Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD. 4+ years of professional experience, 3+ in DevOps, across AWS, Azure and GCP. Currently at Xerago in Chennai delivering on-premises to cloud migrations. Stack includes EKS, AKS, GKE, kubeadm, k3s, Docker, Helm, Harbor, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Argo CD, Terraform, Ansible, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Linux, Proxmox, Bash, Python, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL and MS SQL. Studying for the CKA. Open to relocation to Poland and the EU.
